summary: Apartment-lined street kerb where cars park, homes 19-21 m off.

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings are The Quattro (21 m) and a detached house (19 m) on this side; garages 9 m are non-residential.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parked-car lane along the kerb; a van fits among parked cars.
drivers.traffic: Residential street linking two roads, moderate local traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but 2P resident-permit signs apply Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.

sun_shade: Mostly open to the sky; apartment blocks shade the kerb from the north.

best_section.where: North kerb of Depper Street, beside the garages west of The Quattro
